title: Critique: subjects do not seem to sum to a subject

statements.text: Constitutive Russellian panpsychism needs many microsubjects to combine into a single macrosubject. But, following William James, for any group of subjects and any further subject, it seems possible for the group to exist without the further subject.

sources.quote: given any group of subjects and any further subject, it seems possible for the group to exist without that further subject existing
